parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set protocols isis interface ge-0/0/1.0.template: set protocols isis interface [parameter1] net [parameter2] level [parameter3]
set protocols isis interface ge-0/0/1.0.command: set protocols isis interface ge-0/0/1.0 net 49.0000.0000.0001.00 level 1
set protocols isis interface ge-0/0/1.0.explanation: 配置ISIS协议的接口网络地址及级别。

parameters.name: net
parameters.explanation: ISIS网络实体标题（NET），用于标识ISIS区域。

parameters.name: level
parameters.explanation: ISIS级别，1表示区域内部路由，2表示区域间路由。

set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family inet address 10.1.1.2/24
set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4] vrrp-group [parameter5] virtual-address [parameter6]
set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family inet address 10.1.1.2/24 vrrp-group 1 virtual-address 10.1.1.10
set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码，并加入VRRP组，设置虚拟地址。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

parameters.name: virtual-address
parameters.explanation: VRRP虚拟地址，用于故障转移。

set interfaces ge-0/0/2 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-0/0/2 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/2 unit 0 family inet address 192.168.2.1/24
set interfaces ge-0/0/2 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。
